## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 24 sept. 2026 - 27 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Jesse Churchill_, 27 sept. 2026, 1/5: "CREDIT CARD AUTO PAY CHARGED LATE FEE. My credit card is treated as a backup payment method instead of the main one. They want me to add my bank account but I refuse. The autopay doesn't pull on time and then they charge my card as "the backup" with a late fee. I'M BEING ROBBED. THIS IS SO GHETTO."
            2. _Grace Fern_, 24 sept. 2026, 1/5: "I canceled my membership over a year ago. Now you are trying to collect for late payment. Your records are as bad as your service. Take me off your list."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 10 juil. 2026 - 27 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Gino Guido_, 27 sept. 2026, 1/5: "App very glitchy, password reset glitchy. Needs significant improvement."
            2. _Ar G_, 26 sept. 2026, 1/5: "scam app. Glitchy software makes people pay $35 instead of $15. Not recommended."
            3. _AJey Calloway_, 18 juil. 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined planet fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter planet fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
<!--/ir-theme-->
